title: 全球跨资产高风险机会雷达｜晨间版
one_sentence_conclusion: 混合滞胀再定价：油价与实际利率同升、黄金不涨、股票仅温和回落；只做上移后的油价右尾和事件限损凸性。
meaningful_changes: Saudi Yanbu loadings stopped and some late-September European cargoes were cancelled, converting oil tail risk into physical loss.
Pipeline repair estimates range from days to five-six weeks; old oil strikes and entry bands expired.
10Y closed at 5.00% and real 10Y at 2.62%, while Nasdaq fell only 0.78%; QQQ downside requires failed-rally confirmation.
SOXX rebounded 0.30% and IGV fell 1.01%; the one-day hardware-to-software rotation did not persist.
Gold failed to rise with oil, geopolitical risk and long yields, weakening the policy-credit hypothesis.
